outputs.explanation: Panel A shows only fluorescence micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, Merge) with no plotted summary statistics, so the check does not apply.
Panel B includes micrographs plus two bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity, anti-HMGB1 intensity) showing group means with error bars (n=20) but no individual data points are overlaid.
Panel C is a western blot with no accompanying quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel D includes histochemical micrographs plus two bar charts of signal intensity (SDH and COX) with error bars and sample sizes noted, but no individual data points are shown.

Panel E's data plots are FACS histogram distributions (cell number vs TMRM intensity) rather than bar charts of averages; as line/distribution plots showing the full population, overlaying individual points is not applicable.
